issues_detail.title: Conflicting requiretty Configuration
issues_detail.impact: Contradictory configuration creates confusion; automation mode unclear
issues_detail.fix: Removed initial requiretty line; kept only !requiretty

issues_detail.title: Wildcard Patterns in Sudoers
issues_detail.impact: Wildcards allow arbitrary command/file access; defeats security model
issues_detail.fix: Replaced all 23 wildcard patterns with specific paths/commands
issues_detail.verification: All wildcards replaced with restricted command sets

issues_detail.title: Invalid log_output Parameter
issues_detail.impact: Parameter may not exist in older sudo versions; syntax error potential
issues_detail.fix: Removed log_output= line; kept standard logfile=

issues_detail.title: Missing Environment Variable Restrictions
issues_detail.impact: Missing explicit env_delete allows potential environment injection
issues_detail.fix: Added explicit env_delete for LD_PRELOAD, LD_LIBRARY_PATH, PYTHONPATH
issues_detail.verification: env_delete line added with dangerous vars listed

issues_detail.title: Multiple Binary Paths per Command
issues_detail.impact: Verbose; some binaries may only exist in one location per OS
issues_detail.recommendation: Standardize on /usr/bin/ for cleaner sudoers file
issues_detail.verification: Issue documented; not critical for deployment

issues_detail.title: Unused log_host Parameter
issues_detail.impact: Unnecessary for local file logging; adds confusion

issues_detail.title: Unclear Configuration Documentation
issues_detail.impact: Lack of inline comments on why settings chosen
issues_detail.recommendation: Add comments explaining key security decisions
